name: Sebeonui Kiss
source:
After an office romance nightmare, you vow to start a new life. But before you do, not only does a young & rich boss and a sweet newbie appear, but also a gorgeous police officer next door as well!

[From in-app]
translation:
经历一场噩梦般的办公室恋情后，你发誓要开始全新的生活。可还没来得及迈出这一步，年轻富有的上司、温柔的新同事，甚至连隔壁英俊的警官，都接连出现在你面前！

[摘自应用内]
